title: Legacy bugs linked inline from the spec
body:
This is a list of legacy (Bugzilla) bugs linked inline from the spec. It's generated by html-build by getting a list of bugs from Bugzilla at build time. This slows down the build, so when this list been burned down, that can be removed.

Remove bugs from the list either by resolving them (for WHATWG bugs) or adding `whatwg-resolved` to the whiteboard field if it's fixed or no longer relevant to us.

Grouped by Bugzilla Product:
# WHATWG
